sampling.method: first limit non-pull-request issues returned by the GitHub REST API with state=all, sort=created, direction=asc, and per_page=100
sampling.cohort: oldest available non-pull-request issues at collection time
sampling.limitations: This is a chronological cohort, not a representative random sample. GitHub pagination and issue history can change between collection dates.

note: The default Milestone 0 workflow only prepares this collector; it does not bulk collect.
